Part 1: Merge specimens from other museum datasets into Bulbul_AVONET_data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx)

#My bulbul dataset
bulbuls <- read.csv("../data/Bulbul_AVONET_data.csv")
str(bulbuls)
#Florida Museum of Natural History (FLMNH) dataset
flmnh <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_oac.xlsx")
str(flmnh)
#UPLB Museum of Natural History (UPLB) dataset - Phillipines
uplb <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_uplb_philippines.xlsx")
str(uplb)
uplb$Bill_TotalCulmen <- as.numeric(uplb$Bill_TotalCulmen)
uplb$Bill_FromNostril <- as.numeric(uplb$Bill_FromNostril)
uplb$KD <- uplb$Wing_Chord - uplb$Sec1_Length
#Only keep row 34 and beyond
uplb <- uplb[34:nrow(uplb), ]
#SYSU Guangzhou dataset - China
sysu <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_SYSU_China.xlsx")
str(sysu)
#Steinhardt MNH - Israel
steinhardt <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_Steinhardt_NihanD_Israel.xlsx")
str(steinhardt)
steinhardt$Number <- as.character(steinhardt$Number)
steinhardt$Subspecies <- as.character(steinhardt$Subspecies)
#Field data 1: Wenyi Zhou's field data from China
field1 <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_Wenyi_Zhou_China.xlsx")
str(unique(field1$sp.latin))
# Remove duplicate columns if they exist
field1 <- field1[, !duplicated(colnames(field1))]
field1 <- field1 |>
  filter(sp.latin %in% c(
    "Pycnonotus sinensis",
    "Spizixos semitorques",
    "Hemixos castanonotus",
    "Ixos mcclellandii",
    "Hypsipetes leucocephalus"
  ))
str(field1)
field1$Country_WRI <- "China"
field1$Measurer <- "Wenyi Zhou"
field1$Source <- "Field1"
#Field data 2: Peter Mikula and Martin Hromada's field data from Angola
field2 <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Mikula-Hromada_Sample data sheet.xlsx")
str(field2)
field2 <- field2 |>
  filter(Family == "Pycnonotidae")
str(field2)
field2$Comments <- as.character(field2$Comments)
field2$Wing_Chord <- as.numeric(field2$Wing_Chord)
field2$Date.collected <- as.character(field2$Date.collected)
field2$Collection <- "Field1"
field2$Measurer[field2$Measurer == "Peter Mikula"] <- "PM"
field2$Measurer[field2$Measurer == "Martin Hromada"] <- "MH"
#LSUMNS bulbul data: David Vander Pluym
lsumns <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Bulbul_Vander_Pluym.xlsx")
str(lsumns)
lsumns$Measurer <- "DVP"
lsumns$KD <- lsumns$Wing_Chord - lsumns$Sec_1
lsumns$`Number/Code` <- as.character(lsumns$`Number/Code`)
#Museum data from Peter Mikula (measured by Martin Bulla) - National Museum, Prague, Czechia
nmpc <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Bulla&Mikula_bulbuls_NMP_export.xlsx")
str(nmpc)
nmpc$KD <- nmpc$Wing_Chord - nmpc$Sec_1
nmpc$Measurer <- "MB"
#Cambridge University Museum of Zoology (CUMZ) dataset - UK (part measured by Carla only, Elizabeth yet to be added)
cumzcarla <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample data sheet CJD.xlsx")
cumzelizabeth <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample data sheet EMS.xlsx")
cumz <- bind_rows(cumzcarla, cumzelizabeth)
str(cumz)
for (i in 1:nrow(cumz)) {
  if (cumz$Measurer[i] == "Carla du Toit") {
    cumz$Measurer[i] <- "CJD"
  } else if (cumz$Measurer[i] == "Elizabeth Steell") {
    cumz$Measurer[i] <- "EMS"
  }
}
cumz$Date.collected <- as.numeric(cumz$Date.collected)
#UMICH initial dataset - Probst
umich <- read.csv("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_UMICH_Probst.csv")
str(umich)
umich$KD <- umich$Wing.length - umich$First.secondary.length
umich$Measurer <- "CMP"
umich$Number.Code <- as.character(umich$Number.Code)
#NMNH dataset - Manila, Philippines
nmnh <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_NMNH_Philippines.xlsx")
str(nmnh)
nmnh$Bill_Width <- as.numeric(nmnh$Bill_Width)
nmnh$Bill_Depth <- as.numeric(nmnh$Bill_Depth)
nmnh$Tarsus_Length <- as.numeric(nmnh$Tarsus_Length)
nmnh$Subspecies <- as.character(nmnh$Subspecies)
nmnh$Comments <- as.character(nmnh$Comments)
#Universitas Andalas dataset - Indonesia
ua <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_UA_Muhammad.xlsx")
str(ua)
ua$Measurer <- "MNJ"
ua$Subspecies <- as.character(ua$Subspecies)
#Kansas University Natural History Museum (KUNHM) dataset - Camila Meneses and 1 more colleague
ku <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_KU_CamilaMendes.xlsx")
str(ku)
ku$Measurer[ku$Measurer == "Camila Meneses"] <- "CM"
ku$Measurer[ku$Measurer == "Kier Mitchel Pitogo"] <- "KMP"
#Royal Ontario Museum (ROM) dataset - Vedant Gattani
rom <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_ROM_VG.xlsx")
str(rom)
rom$KD <- rom$Wing_Chord - rom$Sec_1
rom$Date.collected <- as.numeric(rom$Date.collected)
rom$Measurer <- "VG"
#Taiwan Biodiversity Research Institute (TBRI) dataset - Taiwan
tbri <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_TBRI_Stephanie.xlsx")
str(tbri)
tbri$Measurer <- "SYC"
#David Vander Pluym's dataset 2
lsumns2 <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Bulbul_Vander_Pluym_part2.xlsx")
str(lsumns2)
lsumns2$Measurer <- "DVP"
lsumns2$KD <- lsumns2$Wing_Chord - lsumns2$Sec_1
lsumns2$`Number/Code` <- as.character(lsumns2$`Number/Code`)
lsumns2$Date.collected <- as.character(lsumns2$Date.collected)
#Kunming Institute of Zoology (KIZ) dataset - China (Liu Yang and Yue Wu)
kiz <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_KIZ_LiuYang.xlsx")
#Change sex column from 1 and 2 to M and F, and make it a character column
kiz$sex <- as.character(kiz$sex)
kiz$sex[kiz$sex == "1"] <- "M"
kiz$sex[kiz$sex == "2"] <- "F"
#Make Scientific_Name of Brachypodius melanocephalos to Microtarsus melanoleucos to match AVONET
kiz$Scientific_Name[kiz$Scientific_Name == "Brachypodius melanocephalos"] <- "Microtarsus melanoleucos"
str(kiz)
kiz$Measurer <- "YW"

rom <- rom |>
  rename(
    AviList = Scientific_Name,
    Beak.Length_Culmen = Bill_TotalCulmen,
    Beak.Length_Nares = Bill_FromNostril,
    Beak.Width = Bill_Width,
    Beak.Depth = Bill_Depth,
    Gape_Width = Gape.Width,
    Tarsus.Length = Tarsus_Length,
    Kipps.Distance = KD,
    Wing.Length = Wing_Chord,
    Tail.Length = Tail_Length,
    Country_WRI = Country,
    Specimen.number = `Number/Code`,
    Locality = Locality,
    Sex = Sex,
    Subspecies = Subspecies,
    Comments = Comments,
    Measurer = Measurer,
    Source = Collection
  )

field1 <- field1 |>
  rename(
    AviList = sp.latin,
    Tarsus.Length = tarsus,
    Wing.Length = wing.chord,
    Tail.Length = tail,
    Country_WRI = Country_WRI,
    Specimen.number = band.number,
    Sex = sex,
    Measurer = Measurer,
    Source = Source
  )

traits <- c(
"Beak.Length_Culmen",
"Beak.Length_Nares",
"Beak.Width",
"Beak.Depth",
"Tarsus.Length",
"Wing.Length",
"Kipps.Distance",
"Tail.Length",
"Gape_Width"
)

#Merging step with AVONET data - do NOT remove any columns from the AVONET data frame, just add new rows for UMich specimens, and leave NA where information/columns are missing in UMich but present in AVONET
bulbuls <- read.csv("../data/Bulbul_AVONET_data_integrated.csv")
bulbuls2 <- bind_rows(
  bulbuls,
  rom %>% select(any_of(names(bulbuls)))
) %>%
  select(all_of(names(bulbuls)))
str(bulbuls2)

write.csv(bulbuls2, "../data/Bulbul_AVONET_data_integrated.csv", row.names = FALSE)


#AVONET means for each trait, by species
avonet_means <- bulbuls |>
  group_by(AviList) |>
  summarise(
    across(all_of(traits), ~mean(.x, na.rm=TRUE)),
    .groups="drop"
  )
avonet_points <- merge(
  bulbuls,
  avonet_means,
  by="AviList",
  suffixes=c("_specimen","_mean")
)

#Museum means for each trait, by species
rom_means <- rom |>
  group_by(AviList) |>
  summarise(
    across(all_of(traits), ~mean(.x, na.rm=TRUE)),
    .groups="drop"
  )
rom_points <- merge(
  rom,
  avonet_means,
  by="AviList",
  suffixes=c("_rom","_mean")
)

comparison <- merge(
  avonet_means,
  sysu_means,
  by="AviList",
  suffixes=c("_AVONET","_SYSU")
)

#Non-highlighted species mean plots
comparison_long <- comparison %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -AviList,
    names_to = c("Trait", "Dataset"),
    names_pattern = "(.*)_(AVONET|SYSU)",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Dataset,
    values_from = Value
  )

ggplot(comparison_long,
       aes(AVONET, SYSU)) +

  geom_point(size = 3, colour = "#009E73") +

  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +

  facet_wrap(~Trait, scales = "free") +

  theme_classic() +

  labs(
    x = "AVONET species mean",
    y = "SYSU species mean"
  )


#Method 2: Highlighting species with specimen measurements in the SYSU dataset, and comparing those to the AVONET means for those species
rom_species <- rom_points %>%
    filter(!is.na(Wing.Length_rom)) %>%
    pull(AviList) %>%
    unique()

avonet_points_filtered <- avonet_points %>%
    dplyr::filter(AviList %in% rom_species)

avonet_long <- avonet_points_filtered %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with("_specimen"),
    names_to = "Trait",
    names_pattern = "(.*)_specimen",
    values_to = "specimen"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with("_mean"),
    names_to = "Trait_mean",
    names_pattern = "(.*)_mean",
    values_to = "mean"
  ) %>%
  filter(Trait == Trait_mean) %>%
  select(AviList, Trait, specimen, mean)

rom_long <- rom_points %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with("_rom"),
    names_to = "Trait",
    names_pattern = "(.*)_rom",
    values_to = "rom"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with("_mean"),
    names_to = "Trait_mean",
    names_pattern = "(.*)_mean",
    values_to = "mean"
  ) %>%
  filter(Trait == Trait_mean) %>%
  select(AviList, Trait, rom, mean)

ggplot() +

  geom_point(
    data = avonet_long,
    aes(mean, specimen, colour = AviList),
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +

  geom_point(
    data = rom_long,
    aes(mean, rom),
    colour = "#D55E00",
    shape = 17,
    alpha = 0.4,
    size = 1
  ) +

  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +

  facet_wrap(~Trait, scales = "free") +

  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +

  labs(
    x = "AVONET species mean",
    y = "Specimen measurement"
  )

ggsave("../results/Collaborator data comparisons/ROM_comparison_VG.pdf", width = 12, height = 8)


#Checking for specimens that are > 3 standard deviations from the AVONET mean for that species, for any trait

avonet_stats <- bulbuls |>
  group_by(AviList) |>
  summarise(
    culmen_mean = mean(Beak.Length_Culmen, na.rm=TRUE),
    culmen_sd = sd(Beak.Length_Culmen, na.rm=TRUE),
    .groups="drop"
  )

florida_check <- merge(
  flmnh,
  avonet_stats,
  by="AviList"
)

florida_check$outlier <-
abs(florida_check$Beak.Length_Culmen - florida_check$culmen_mean) >
2*florida_check$culmen_sd


```
